design_rules: Use the registered probe wrapper exactly and change only the registered shared-decision salience state within each pair.
Downstream prompts are standalone attention-budget episodes with new tasks and distractors. Do not state the target state, and include exactly one response contract with no probe suffix.
Do not ask the model to label goal shielding, persistence, or plan flexibility.

probe_train.instructions: Generate complete matched probe pairs with the exact registered wrapper. Keep objectives, actors, and wording identical within a pair except the registered shared-decision salience clause inside Scenario; append nothing after the wrapper.

probe_validation.instructions: Generate new matched validation probe pairs with the exact registered wrapper. Change only the registered shared-decision salience clause; append nothing after the wrapper.

probe_heldout.instructions: Generate held-out matched probe pairs with the exact registered wrapper and new domains. Change only the registered shared-decision salience clause; append nothing after the wrapper.

behavior_eval.instructions: Generate standalone attention-budget items with assigned metadata. Use new tasks and distractors, avoid target-state labels, and include exactly one two-integer response contract.

steering_eval.instructions: Generate a distinct standalone attention-budget pool with the same metadata schedule. Avoid target-state labels and include exactly one response contract.

calibration.instructions: Generate neutral standalone attention-budget items for calibration. Avoid priority labels and include exactly one response contract.
